_about: The nightly job list (B448 P5, ADR-209 item 4). To add a job, add ONE entry here and nothing else: tools/nightly/run.py, ./verify and the workflow never change. name: unique. command: a shell line run from the repo root; it must exit 0 to pass. platforms: any of linux, macos. floor: the fewest cases the job must judge; 0 means it is not a corpus loop. A job with a floor must print the line KIT-GATE cases=<n>; a job that cannot run here prints KIT-GATE skipped: <reason> and exits 0, which the receipt records as skipped, never as ran. See tools/nightly/README.md.

jobs.name: fuzz-h2-engines
jobs.command: cmake -S . -B build-nightly -G "Unix Makefiles" -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release && cmake --build build-nightly --target h2_harness_render -j 4 && node tools/h2_fuzz_check.mjs --deep --cases 20000 --bin build-nightly/h2_harness_render

jobs.name: soak-h2-long
jobs.command: cmake -S . -B build-nightly -G "Unix Makefiles" -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release && cmake --build build-nightly --target h2_harness_render -j 4 && node tools/h2_soak_check.mjs --size long --night "$(( $(date -u +%s) / 86400 ))" --bin build-nightly/h2_harness_render

jobs.name: soak-h2-extreme
jobs.command: cmake -S . -B build-nightly -G "Unix Makefiles" -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release && cmake --build build-nightly --target h2_harness_render -j 4 && node tools/h2_soak_check.mjs --size extreme --night "$(( $(date -u +%s) / 86400 ))" --bin build-nightly/h2_harness_render
